stories.title: Trump administration files third Supreme Court appeal over mail ballot restrictions
stories.description: The Sunday filing urges justices to act immediately as states begin sending ballots, with North Carolina already mailing and Alabama days away.

stories.title: Iran funnels billions through US banks despite sanctions, WSJ finds
stories.description: A Wall Street Journal investigation reveals Tehran exploits correspondent banking and shell companies to move funds through American clearing accounts.

stories.title: IRGC attacks six ships after US destroys Iranian tankers
stories.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guard said it struck six vessels in retaliation after U.S. forces destroyed three Iranian oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday.

stories.title: OpenAI admits AI agents hijacked German wiki, vows new disclosure rules
stories.description: The company acknowledged the incident after a Reuters report and said it will publish a framework for reporting rogue AI behavior within weeks.

stories.title: Huckabee calls violent Israeli settlers 'terrorists' during West Bank visit
stories.description: The U.S. ambassador to Israel visited Turmus Ayya on Saturday, urging "severe consequences" for settlers attacking Palestinian Americans.

stories.title: Trump drafts plan to pay stay-at-home parents with child care funds
stories.description: The policy, championed by VP Vance, would redirect subsidies from a program already facing waitlists in 23 states.

stories.title: U.S. to phase out $45M in annual HIV funding for Namibia
stories.description: The move follows Namibia's rejection of U.S. demands to share health data and biological specimens, citing sovereignty and privacy concerns.

stories.title: Guyana receives Cuban, Afghan deportees under U.S. third-country policy
stories.description: Six nationals of Cuba and Afghanistan arrived Friday under a one-year agreement that does not constitute permanent resettlement.

stories.title: Trump-backed MAGA Inc. drops $10M on Texas Senate race
stories.description: The ad buy is the PAC's first major midterm expenditure, targeting the competitive Paxton-Talarico contest after Trump pledged up to $500 million for GOP candidates.

stories.title: Missouri asks Supreme Court to reinstate Trump-backed congressional map
stories.description: Attorney General Hanaway filed an emergency appeal Friday after the state's highest court unanimously blocked the redrawn districts for the November midterms.

stories.title: Two guards charged in first Alligator Alcatraz abuse case
stories.description: Florida also seeks $250 million more to cover bills from the closed Everglades detention center as federal reimbursement remains stalled.

stories.title: ICE officer pleads not guilty to lying about Minneapolis shooting
stories.description: The case marks the first federal prosecution of an officer involved in Operation Metro Surge, the Trump administration's immigration crackdown.

stories.title: Anthropic delays IPO launch to mid-October
stories.description: The AI company's prospectus is now expected in late September, pushing back what could be one of the largest IPOs ever attempted.

stories.title: Pentagon polygraphs 50 Joint Staff members in war leak probe
stories.description: Investigators questioned military officers and civilians about disclosing classified details on munitions shortages caused by the Iran war.

stories.title: Trump says DC building spree is to monument himself
stories.description: The president told New York Magazine "nobody will do it once I'm gone," acknowledging his construction projects are legacy-driven.

stories.title: ICE subpoenaed REI for all green beanie buyers in Minneapolis area
stories.description: Court filings reveal the subpoena was among 92 issued by Homeland Security agents investigating a January anti-ICE church protest.

stories.title: US intel: Iran may escalate war ahead of midterms
stories.description: Intelligence reports suggest Tehran sees the unpopular conflict and high gas prices as leverage over Republicans before November's elections.

stories.title: US measles cases hit 35-year high as infant death confirmed in Pennsylvania
stories.description: A coroner confirmed a 6-week-old Amish baby died of measles in Lancaster County as national cases surpassed 3,100, the most since 1991.

stories.title: DHS expands birthright citizenship exception beyond foreign diplomats
stories.description: The interim rule redefines "foreign government employees" to include embassy, consulate, and international organization staff, denying their U.S.-born children citizenship.

stories.title: Trump calls Iran conflict 'small potatoes,' backs Vance's rejection of 'war' label
stories.description: The president described six months of U.S. strikes on Iran as a "military conflict," not a war, as midterm elections approach.

stories.title: UN votes 164-1 to promote maps showing Africa's true size
stories.description: The General Assembly endorsed a resolution encouraging adoption of Equal Earth and other equal-area projections over the 16th-century Mercator map.

stories.title: Supreme Court lets GOP access discounted TV ad rates ahead of midterms
stories.description: The justices halted a lower-court ruling that had blocked Republican party committees from receiving cheaper broadcast advertising time before November.

stories.title: WSJ report details Fetterman dodging constituents, gaming Senate attendance
stories.description: Pennsylvania Democrats call Fetterman "a disgrace" after the Journal revealed he skipped veteran meetings for Fox News appearances.

stories.title: DOJ antitrust division halts cooperation with Canada
stories.description: The directive, reported by The Wall Street Journal, opens a new front in the escalating U.S.-Canada trade war.

stories.title: U.S. approves $5.75B in arms sales to Saudi Arabia
stories.description: The State Department cleared two deals Friday covering precision-guided bomb kits and tank engines as Middle East war drives surging weapons demand.

stories.title: Judge orders DOJ to name architects of Trump weaponization fund
stories.description: A Virginia magistrate judge ruled Friday that the Justice Department must disclose who designed the now-defunct $1.8 billion fund.

stories.title: Iran says it's finding ways around US naval blockade
stories.description: Oil Minister Paknejad claims Tehran is circumventing the blockade, but tracking data shows crude exports have collapsed to near zero.

stories.title: US adds 162,000 jobs in August, tripling forecasts
stories.description: The unemployment rate held at 4.1% as hiring rebounded sharply from July's contraction, raising pressure on the Fed ahead of its Sept. 16 meeting.

stories.title: Trump to fly Qatari jet to Ireland despite unresolved security gaps
stories.description: The trip next week marks the plane's first overseas use since an Iranian threat forced the president to secretly switch aircraft in Turkey in July.

stories.title: Denmark says Russia is planning sabotage against its defense industry
stories.description: PET revealed that Russian intelligence is recruiting Danes to scout defense firms linked to Ukraine aid, citing arson as a possible objective.

stories.title: Argentina's Milei declares Falklands 'Argentinean,' sanctions oil firms
stories.description: The address came hours after Trump hinted the U.S. would not back Britain over the islands, citing the UK's refusal to join the Iran campaign.

stories.title: Trump warns US may strike Iran's Pickaxe Mountain
stories.description: The heavily fortified site near the Natanz nuclear facility hosts deeply buried tunnel complexes allegedly tied to Iran's nuclear program.

stories.title: 30-year mortgage rate hits 13-month high as bond yields surge
stories.description: Freddie Mac said Thursday the benchmark rate rose to 6.71%, its highest since July 2025, as rising Treasury yields squeeze homebuyers.

stories.title: ICE whistleblower says agency skipped vetting in rush to hire thousands of officers
stories.description: A senior official alleged recruits received job offers before fingerprinting or identity checks were completed, creating national security risks.

stories.title: China warns G20 row could threaten Xi-Trump summit
stories.description: Beijing says U.S. accusations over a blocked G20 communiqué risk damaging relations ahead of Xi Jinping's Sept. 24 White House visit.

stories.title: Vance refuses to set timeline for ending Iran conflict
stories.description: The vice president called it "irresponsible" to project an end date, declining to even call the six-month-old confrontation a war.

stories.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Astra, declares 'AGI era'
stories.description: The company's most powerful model yet can autonomously operate software and exploit cybersecurity flaws, raising sharp safety concerns.

stories.title: Trump threatens to halt trade with deficit nations unless Fed cuts rates
stories.description: The president issued the ultimatum on Truth Social after a stronger-than-expected August jobs report showing 162,000 new positions.

stories.title: Vance refuses to disavow Carlson despite GOP antisemitism pressure
stories.description: The vice president said he won't "throw friends under the bus," even as Republican leaders warn the Carlson tie threatens his 2028 prospects.

stories.title: G20 unanimously endorses US-backed 'Carolina Principles' AI framework
stories.description: The non-binding Carolina Principles call on nations to avoid new AI regulatory bodies and work more closely with private industry.

stories.title: IG report details toxic workplace under ex-Labor Secretary
stories.description: More than three dozen witnesses described a "toxic, intimidating and humiliating" environment under Lori Chavez-DeRemer, who resigned in April.

stories.title: Pentagon pulls testosterone screening guidance one day after publishing it
stories.description: The clinical guidelines for mandatory testing of troops 30 and older were removed Thursday "to allow for updates," a U.S. official said.

stories.title: Leon Black sues House Oversight to block Epstein probe subpoenas
stories.description: The Apollo Global Management co-founder filed suit Thursday and refused to appear for a scheduled deposition, prompting calls for contempt.

stories.title: Trump admin proposes stripping tax exemptions from schools with DEI policies
stories.description: The Treasury Department and IRS proposed rules that could affect up to 18,000 private schools offering race-based programs in admissions, scholarships and more.

stories.title: US trade deficit jumps to $88.6B on AI import surge
stories.description: The gap grew 24.4% in July to $88.6 billion as computer and semiconductor imports soared while crude oil and gold exports fell sharply.

stories.title: Nvidia to acquire Hugging Face for nearly $13 billion
stories.description: The chipmaker's second-largest deal gives it ownership of the leading open-source AI platform used by 18 million developers.

stories.title: Trump taps Adam Telle as acting Army secretary
stories.description: The appointment bypasses the normal line of succession and follows Dan Driscoll's resignation amid clashes with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

stories.title: Gloria Steinem, feminist icon and Ms. Magazine co-founder, dies at 92
stories.description: The trailblazing journalist and activist died Wednesday at her home in New York City, her foundation announced. A cause of death was not given.

stories.title: Judge grills NYC landlords challenging rent freeze
stories.description: A Manhattan judge heard nearly six hours of arguments Wednesday in a lawsuit seeking to overturn the historic freeze on 1 million stabilized apartments before it takes effect Oct. 1.

stories.title: Trump warns Canada's economy will 'collapse' as trade war with Ottawa deepens
stories.description: Canada's retaliatory tariffs on U.S. goods take effect Sept. 8, with neither side showing signs of backing down after talks collapsed Aug. 21.

stories.title: House Democrats block amendment to cap Supreme Court at 9
stories.description: The Republican-backed measure won a simple majority but fell short of the two-thirds supermajority needed under expedited rules.

stories.title: Coast Guard jet carrying DHS Secretary Mullin makes emergency landing after engine failure
stories.description: The aging aircraft, which DHS flagged last year as beyond its service life, lost its right engine mid-flight Wednesday with 14 people aboard.

stories.title: State Dept. rule would require parents prove status for children's passports
stories.description: The proposal is the first detailed framework for enforcing Trump's August executive order targeting "birth tourism."

stories.title: Judge rejects DOJ bid to break up Google's ad tech business
stories.description: The ruling marks the third consecutive failed attempt by federal antitrust enforcers to force a Big Tech company to divest assets.

stories.title: Iran seizes fuel-smuggling ship in Gulf, arrests 11 crew
stories.description: The seizure follows Iran's detention of a bulk carrier for dumping oil waste into the Strait of Hormuz, as Tehran steps up maritime enforcement.

stories.title: NYC bans AI for 600,000 students through 8th grade
stories.description: The nation's largest school district is imposing a one-year moratorium on generative AI for pre-K through middle school, along with strict new screen time limits.

stories.title: US presses NATO allies to accelerate defense readiness amid Russian hybrid attacks
stories.description: Leaked intelligence suggests Russia could strike a NATO nation sooner than expected, as drone attacks and sabotage incidents escalate across Europe.

stories.title: USS Abraham Lincoln docks in Thailand after record 250 days at sea
stories.description: The carrier's nearly 5,000 crew members began shore leave in Pattaya after an unprecedented deployment extended by the Iran conflict.

stories.title: US allies push back on tariffs, currency move at G20
stories.description: European and Canadian officials openly criticized Trump administration trade and currency policies at the G20 finance ministers meeting in Asheville.

stories.title: Tyler Robinson to stand trial for Charlie Kirk killing
stories.description: Robinson, 23, pleaded not guilty to aggravated murder after a Utah judge ruled prosecutors can pursue the death penalty.

stories.title: House censures Rep. Chuck Edwards over conduct with female staffers
stories.description: The 413-2 vote made the North Carolina Republican the rare lawmaker formally rebuked by a chamber his own party controls.

stories.title: Greer says 'no negotiations' with Canada as tariff deadline looms
stories.description: The U.S. trade representative dismissed urgency to restart talks, with Canada's retaliatory tariffs on over 700 American products set to take effect Sept. 8.

stories.title: China demands rights in Venezuela after U.S. firm takes over oilfields
stories.description: Beijing pushed back after NABEP, backed by Washington, was granted control of 17 Venezuelan oilfields previously run by Chinese and Russian companies.

stories.title: House passes funding bill, averting shutdown before midterms
stories.description: The continuing resolution, which funds the government through Dec. 11, now heads to President Trump, who is expected to sign it.

stories.title: Erdogan signals new nuclear plant projects with Russia
stories.description: Turkey's president said the two countries will pursue additional power plants beyond the nearly completed Akkuyu facility on the Mediterranean coast.

stories.title: Iran says it has enough reserves after Bessent warns of economic collapse
stories.description: Iran's central bank governor vowed to inject $2 billion to stabilize markets, calling U.S. collapse warnings "psychological warfare."

stories.title: Xi urges 'universal security' at SCO summit in Bishkek
stories.description: Leaders from China, Russia, India and other Eurasian nations gathered for the bloc's 25th anniversary amid overlapping global conflicts.

stories.title: Bessent tells Russia no relief until Ukraine war ends
stories.description: The Treasury secretary met with his Russian counterpart at the G20 in Asheville, marking a rare direct exchange between Washington and Moscow.

stories.title: Yemen warns Houthi-al-Qaeda ties could spread terror across Africa
stories.description: Yemen's military spokesman says the alliance is "already transnational" and could transfer drone and missile expertise to al-Qaeda affiliates in Africa.

stories.title: Ex-gang leader found guilty in Tupac Shakur murder
stories.description: Duane "Keffe D" Davis faces up to life in prison after a Las Vegas jury convicted him of first-degree murder in the 1996 drive-by killing.

stories.title: Trump calls nuclear weapon question 'stupid' after US resumes Iran strikes
stories.description: The president rejected the idea of using nuclear weapons against Iran, saying it was militarily defeated and there was "no reason for it."

stories.title: Europeans protest Russia's return to G20 finance meeting in North Carolina
stories.description: European officials threatened to boycott the group photo and confronted Russia's finance minister over the Ukraine war at the U.S.-hosted summit.

stories.title: Vance rallies with Rogers as El-Sayed courts Jewish Democrats in Michigan
stories.description: Vice President JD Vance joined Republican Senate nominee Mike Rogers at a Sterling Heights event as Democrat Abdul El-Sayed apologized over synagogue attack remarks.

stories.title: FTC sues Amazon over alleged ad price manipulation
stories.description: The agency claims Amazon secretly inflated ad costs over seven years, backed by more than 20 state attorneys general.

stories.title: China demands US prove AI oversight before talks
stories.description: Beijing says Washington must show its AI firms face the same safety and audit rules before September negotiations can proceed.

stories.title: Bessent meets Russian delegation at G20 to push Trump's Ukraine peace plan
stories.description: The U.S. Treasury secretary held talks with a Russian group including Sergey Lavrov at the G20 Finance Ministerial in Asheville, North Carolina.

stories.title: Kalshi issues first-ever lifetime ban to George Santos
stories.description: The prediction market platform also fined Santos $71,356 after federal regulators found he manipulated bets on his State of the Union attendance.

stories.title: Putin chose to escalate Ukraine war, The Economist reports
stories.description: Sources say the Russian president fears ending the war without capturing Donbas could endanger his life, telling associates, "They will hang me."

stories.title: Trump urges US to 'let Data Reign,' warns towns opposing data centers
stories.description: The president's strongest defense yet of AI infrastructure comes as data center backlash emerges as a key midterm election issue.

stories.title: Taliban offers US access to Afghanistan's mineral wealth
stories.description: Foreign Minister Muttaqi told the Financial Times that Kabul would welcome American investment in mining, infrastructure and trade.

stories.title: 'Functional unemployment' hits 24.9% even as official jobless rate falls
stories.description: The Ludwig Institute says nearly 1 in 4 U.S. workers is functionally unemployed, a fourth straight monthly increase that contrasts with the Fed's rosy outlook.

stories.title: Trump says NBC's Welker will be reported to FCC
stories.description: The president accused the "Meet the Press" host of misrepresenting his endorsement record, seeking her "rebuke or punishment."

stories.title: Venezuela oil deal draws fire from opposition and government allies alike
stories.description: Edmundo González warned Sunday that revenues from the U.S.-Venezuela oil agreement risk benefiting only "some" rather than all citizens.

stories.title: Pentagon to take 35% stake in Venezuela oil venture
stories.description: The Defense Department plans to invest in a private company granted 100-year rights to develop 17 Venezuelan oil fields holding 65 billion barrels.

stories.title: Iceland votes against resuming EU membership talks
stories.description: Voters rejected the proposal 52.5% to 47.5%, settling the question for a second time after accession talks were abandoned in 2015.

stories.title: NBC News crew and Palestinian woman beaten by masked Israeli settlers in West Bank
stories.description: Netanyahu condemned the attack in Jalud as Israeli security forces said they confiscated settler vehicles and opened a police investigation.

stories.title: Man charged with arson after setting himself on fire in NYC Google building
stories.description: John Butch, 63, allegedly used lighter fluid to self-immolate Friday in the lobby of a Lower Manhattan building housing Google and NYPD offices.

stories.title: DHS deports pro-deportation commentator Yiannopoulos to UK
stories.description: The far-right British provocateur, who called for ICE checkpoints and mass deportations, was himself removed after overstaying his visa since 2019.

stories.title: Crockett declines to campaign with Talarico in Texas Senate race
stories.description: The congresswoman told CNN she will focus on down-ballot candidates, declining to join the Democratic nominee who defeated her in the March primary.

stories.title: NPS endorses Trump's arch despite harm to 36 DC landmarks
stories.description: A 133-page report found the proposed 250-foot gilded arch would disrupt sightlines across Washington but called its Memorial Circle site irreplaceable.

stories.title: Hegseth weighs summoning military leaders to Quantico again
stories.description: The defense secretary could use a second large-scale gathering to announce new directives, according to the Wall Street Journal.

stories.title: US sanctions Egyptian bank's UAE branches over Iran ties
stories.description: Treasury moved to cut Banque Misr's six UAE branches from the U.S. financial system, calling them a "critical node" for Iranian dollar access.

stories.title: Judge blocks Trump deportation of pro-Palestinian students
stories.description: A federal judge ruled that two immigration law provisions used to target noncitizen students over pro-Palestinian speech violate the First and Fifth Amendments.

stories.title: Fed Chair Warsh signals rate hikes may be needed as inflation stays elevated
stories.description: In his Jackson Hole debut, Warsh said underlying inflation trends have not "meaningfully improved" and current rates may not be restricting growth.

stories.title: Pakistan says it won't comply with US sanctions on Iran
stories.description: Islamabad joins Beijing in rejecting Washington's "Operation Economic Outcast," vowing to continue and expand trade with Tehran.

stories.title: Trump administration quietly pushing to give Yosemite land to private developer
stories.description: A NOTUS investigation found the National Park Service has spent over a year working to cede a strip of parkland to a Nevada real estate firm.

stories.title: Norway's King Harald V dies at 89 after weeks in hospital
stories.description: Europe's oldest reigning monarch died peacefully Friday morning at Oslo University Hospital after battling a bacterial blood infection.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia nears renewed war with Houthis as oil routes come under siege
stories.description: Diplomatic channels have collapsed after weeks of Houthi attacks on Saudi ships and oil facilities, with analysts warning that full-scale conflict appears imminent.

stories.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to allow discharge of transgender troops
stories.description: The DOJ filed a petition Friday seeking to overturn lower court rulings that block the Pentagon from removing about 4,200 transgender service members.

stories.title: Venezuela weighs leaving OPEC as US oil ties deepen
stories.description: A founding member of the 65-year-old cartel is in talks with Washington about a departure that would mark the second exit in months.

stories.title: FDA approves updated COVID vaccines targeting XFG variant
stories.description: Shots from Moderna, Pfizer-BioNTech, and Novavax-Sanofi are approved for older adults and high-risk individuals ahead of fall.

stories.title: Federal judge blocks Trump's bid to erase hush money conviction for third time
stories.description: Judge Hellerstein ruled Trump's presidential immunity arguments were "neither new nor legally sufficient" to move the case to federal court.

stories.title: New York AG sues last sheriff defying state's ICE ban
stories.description: Attorney General Letitia James filed suit Thursday against Rensselaer County's sheriff for refusing to end his office's cooperation agreement with ICE.

stories.title: FAA moves to fire two controllers who left early before fatal LaGuardia crash
stories.description: Two air traffic controllers departed about an hour before their shifts ended on the night of the deadly March 22 collision.

stories.title: Trump admin drafts rule to block China's remote AI chip access
stories.description: The Commerce Department could share the proposed export control with industry groups as early as September, though legal hurdles loom.

stories.title: OpenAI, Anthropic lead 100+ firms in AI cyber threat warning
stories.description: The open letter urges governments and businesses to treat cyber defense as an immediate priority before AI-powered attacks overwhelm critical infrastructure.

stories.title: Documents contradict RFK Jr.'s claim Samoa trip was unrelated to vaccines
stories.description: Letters show Kennedy wrote Samoa's prime minister proposing to study MMR vaccines before his 2019 visit, despite telling senators the trip had "nothing to do with vaccines."

stories.title: Judge blocks Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic
stories.description: The ruling found the Trump administration's supply-chain risk designation violated the AI company's First and Fifth Amendment rights.

stories.title: Iran war's drain on US weapons stockpiles alarms Asian allies
stories.description: Six months into the conflict, dwindling Patriot and Tomahawk missile supplies are raising fears about U.S. readiness for a potential confrontation with China.

stories.title: Hamas agrees to surrender weapons in historic first, Board of Peace says
stories.description: The group accepted a 15-point roadmap for full disarmament and governance transfer, but Israel's rejection has stalled implementation.

stories.title: Most people arrested by ICE in July had no criminal record, data shows
stories.description: Federal data reveals ICE averaged over 1,580 arrests daily in July, with more than half involving people with no criminal history.

stories.title: Four EU states urge Brussels to unlock frozen Russian assets for Ukraine
stories.description: Sweden, the Netherlands, Spain, and Poland sent a letter calling on the European Commission to restart work on using over €200 billion in frozen Russian funds.

stories.title: Secret Service places 3 officials on leave amid misconduct probe
stories.description: The agency's communications chief and two colleagues lost their security clearances as the Office of Professional Responsibility investigates undisclosed allegations.

stories.title: Trump DOJ raises doubts about prosecuting Fauci for contempt of Congress
stories.description: Administration officials question whether the legal strategy behind the Senate's contempt referral is strong enough to support an indictment.

stories.title: Haiti gang threatens to kill 50 hostages after Kenscoff massacre
stories.description: A gang leader posted a video Wednesday showing captives and warning they would be executed if security forces continue operations.

stories.title: Nvidia shares rally after Q2 revenue doubles, topping estimates
stories.description: CEO Jensen Huang said AI has reached an "inflection point" as the chipmaker posted $96.2 billion in quarterly revenue and guided above consensus.

stories.title: Trump admin proposes treating billion-dollar firms as small businesses
stories.description: The rule would raise size thresholds dramatically, allowing companies with up to $1 billion in revenue to access federal contracts and loans reserved for small firms.

stories.title: Appeals court rules Rep. McIver must face assault trial
stories.description: A divided Third Circuit panel found the Speech or Debate Clause does not shield McIver from charges tied to a confrontation at a Newark detention facility.

stories.title: FDA approves first drug targeting genetic driver of pancreatic cancer
stories.description: Rasonque, made by Revolution Medicines, nearly doubled survival time in trials and was approved 6.5 months ahead of schedule.

stories.title: Cook's lawyer says no grounds for Trump to fire Fed governor
stories.description: Attorney Abbe David Lowell called mortgage fraud allegations "unfounded and untrue" in a letter sent to the White House on Wednesday.

stories.title: DHS admits its noncitizen voter roll figures were inflated
stories.description: After claiming nearly 16,000 noncitizens were on Nevada's rolls, DHS provided a list of just 185 and declined to share supporting data.

stories.title: Bill Gates warns 'there is no plan' for AI upheaval in new essay
stories.description: The Microsoft co-founder calls for global regulation, new institutions and an AI tax, warning of mass job loss and rising security threats.

stories.title: DeSantis calls Flock cameras 'out of control' amid bipartisan revolt
stories.description: Over 100 cities have dropped Flock Safety's license plate readers as lawmakers push federal legislation to curb AI-powered surveillance.

stories.title: Trump says Iran's Khamenei alive but 'very seriously wounded'
stories.description: The president offered his most detailed assessment of the Iranian Supreme Leader, who has not been seen publicly since the February strikes that killed his father.

stories.title: Same-name challenger advances to Alaska Senate general election
stories.description: Dan J. Sullivan, a retired teacher, secured a spot alongside incumbent Sen. Dan Sullivan and Democrat Mary Peltola in November's ranked-choice contest.

stories.title: Dolly Parton, queen of country music, dies at 80
stories.description: The singer-songwriter, actress and entrepreneur who rose from rural Tennessee poverty to global stardom died Tuesday, her family said.

stories.title: Trump administration pauses visa appointments worldwide
stories.description: The State Department cited a "global training initiative" for consular officers, days after a judge struck down a 75-country visa ban.

stories.title: China vows to fight back after US sanctions Chinese entities over Iran ties
stories.description: Beijing warned it will take "all necessary measures" to protect its interests after Washington sanctioned over 60 entities in its "Operation Economic Outcast" campaign.

stories.title: Ukraine stages world's first drone-only military parade
stories.description: Unmanned ground vehicles, naval drones, and aerial systems replaced soldiers on Kyiv's streets to mark 35 years of independence.

stories.title: Darline Graham wins SC GOP Senate runoff, validating Trump endorsement
stories.description: Graham defeated Rep. Ralph Norman on Tuesday despite debate gaffe concerns, and will face a Democrat in November as the heavy favorite.

stories.title: US declines to join 50-nation UN rebuke of Russia over Ukraine strikes
stories.description: Washington again broke with allies, calling on "both sides" to negotiate instead of condemning Russian aggression at a Security Council session.

stories.title: Grocers sue NYC over city-run supermarket plan
stories.description: The Multicultural Business Coalition filed two lawsuits Monday to block Mayor Mamdani's $70 million plan for five government-owned grocery stores.

stories.title: Trump sends Saudi nuclear deal to Congress, ties it to Israel recognition
stories.description: The 30-year pact, reached in July, would allow U.S. exports of civilian nuclear technology to the kingdom, including AP1000 reactors.

stories.title: AI-guided Russian drone killed 3 Ukrainians autonomously, officials say
stories.description: Ukrainian officials say a drone with no human pilot made the targeting decision, marking the war's first confirmed fully autonomous AI weapon strike.

stories.title: EU approves $7.1 billion in defense aid for Ukraine
stories.description: The funding, announced on Ukraine's Independence Day, targets air defense systems, missiles, ammunition, and radars as Russian aerial attacks intensify.

stories.title: US intel warned Trump killing Khamenei would backfire, WSJ reports
stories.description: Six months into the Iran conflict, a Wall Street Journal investigation reveals intelligence officials cautioned Trump the operation could empower a more extreme regime.

stories.title: Iran threatens fines, detention for ships violating Hormuz transit rules
stories.description: The warning from Tehran's new maritime authority escalates tensions as the U.S. prepares to roll out sweeping new sanctions against Iran on Monday.

stories.title: Florida start-up making low-cost drone interceptors for the Iran war
stories.description: Powerus is producing its Guardian interceptor locally in the Emirates to fill gaps in allied air defenses as the U.S.-Iran war drains American-made stockpiles.

stories.title: Nevada sues to block Trump administration's Colorado River cuts
stories.description: The lawsuit, the first legal challenge to the plan finalized Friday, alleges cuts of up to 71% to Nevada's allocation could devastate Las Vegas.

stories.title: Over 200 Chinese vessels mass near Philippine reef as Beijing announces live-fire drills
stories.description: Satellite imagery shows fishing boats in militia-like formations at Mischief Reef, raising fears of a move on Second Thomas Shoal.

stories.title: Zelenskyy denies Ukraine role in Nord Stream blasts
stories.description: The Ukrainian president spoke after a second Ukrainian suspect was arrested in Croatia over the 2022 pipeline sabotage.

stories.title: Trump plans to revoke 200,000 visas from asylum seekers
stories.description: The move would be the largest single visa revocation in U.S. history, targeting those who entered on tourist or business visas.

stories.title: Syria set to leave U.S. terrorism sponsor list after 47 years
stories.description: Congress's 45-day review period expired Saturday without opposition, clearing the way for formal removal pending Federal Register publication.

stories.title: Iran urges Qatar to move detained pilots to hospital on land
stories.description: Tehran claims the airmen are being held on water in poor condition, but Qatar denies holding any surviving pilots.

stories.title: Trump threatens to double tariffs on Canadian autos to 50% in January
stories.description: The announcement escalates a trade war with Ottawa days after bilateral negotiations collapsed, with Canada vowing to retaliate "dollar for dollar."

stories.title: FDA urges recall of alfalfa sprouts tied to E. coli outbreak in 15 states
stories.description: At least 55 people have been sickened and four hospitalized in a dual E. coli and salmonella outbreak linked to a Minnesota sprout grower.

stories.title: Supreme Court lets White House ballroom construction continue
stories.description: Chief Justice Roberts froze a lower court order that would have halted the $400 million project at midnight, buying time for the justices to review the case.

stories.title: Trump disclosure reveals 1,000 stock trades in June
stories.description: A filing released Friday shows the president sold Meta shares and bought Berkshire Hathaway amid a broad portfolio reshuffling.

stories.title: Cuba says US sanctions undercut the economic reforms Washington long demanded
stories.description: Havana's UN ambassador questioned why Washington keeps escalating penalties even as Cuba opens its economy to private investment and foreign business.

stories.title: NATO's eastern allies offer to cover US base costs amid troop review
stories.description: Frontline states are preparing a cost-sharing bid ahead of a meeting with a Pentagon official next week, hoping to keep American forces in the region.

top.title: Trump administration files third Supreme Court appeal over mail ballot restrictions
top.description: The Sunday filing urges justices to act immediately as states begin sending ballots, with North Carolina already mailing and Alabama days away.

top.title: Iran funnels billions through US banks despite sanctions, WSJ finds
